title: Project-level further reading
description: A flat list of sources relevant to the ontology as a whole, shown in the sidebar's "Find out more" section. Listing is not an endorsement, and linked works may use terms differently to this ontology. Per-node reading lives in the node's own additional_resources field.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique within the file.

label.description: Title of the work, as the reader would recognise it.

url.description: Absolute URL. Prefer a DOI-resolving URL where one exists.

doi.description: Bare DOI, without the https://doi.org/ prefix.

publisher.description: Publishing body or journal, shown as context next to the link.

note.description: Why this source is worth following.
